entities.summary: Magdalena Crispin Shauri is a Tanzanian long distance runner. She competed in the women's marathon at the 2017 World Championships in Athletics. In 2019, she competed in the senior women's race at the 2019 IAAF World Cross Country Championships. She finished in 49th place. In the 2024 Olympic Games marathon in Paris, she ran a time of 2:31:58, good for 40th place.
